ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS:
- The Borrower's obligation to pay all reasonable and documented costs and expenses of the Agent related to the preparation and execution of the amendment (Section 5).
- As a condition to effectiveness, the Borrower must provide a fully executed amendment to the Deposit Account Control Agreement dated January 25, 2019, with Bank of America, N.A. (Section 4(b)).
- As a condition to effectiveness, the Borrower must provide a fully executed termination agreement for the Deposit Account Control Agreement dated February 4, 2019, with Bank of America, N.A. (Section 4(c)).
- The Borrower provides a full and complete release of the Agent and Lenders from any and all past claims (Section 6, "Lender Release").
